title: Taiwanese American Student Association at the University of Michigan
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Student Association (TASA) at the University of Michigan is a student organization dedicated to preserving and promoting Taiwanese culture among second-generation Taiwanese American students and the broader University of Michigan campus community. The organization also seeks to foster networks among its members. TASA is registered in the university’s official Maize Pages club directory and is recognized by the LSA Asian Languages and Cultures department’s student organization listing.

TASA maintains active presences on Instagram (@tasa_umich, 1,083 followers), Facebook, a university-hosted website, and a Linktree. The organization’s flagship annual event is Taste of Taiwan, a large-scale Taiwanese night market co-hosted with TWSA that features food, cultural games such as mahjong and Chinese chess, and performances by campus organizations. The event has been documented as recently as March 2025. An executive board structure is in place, with positions including co-presidents, family relations chairs, outreach chairs, internal programming chairs, publicity chairs, and a treasurer.
